assets.title: 加载 · 山林晨光
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a high-quality original portrait 9:16 background image for a mobile mushroom match-three game, designed for actual interface compositing. Art direction: believable Chinese subtropical mountain woodland, finely observed natural surfaces, photographic realism softened with atmospheric depth and intentional art direction, sophisticated and welcoming. Restrained natural palette, soft upper-left daylight, no neon, no glossy plastic, no fantasy glow. No interface, no text, no logos, no border, no phone device, no human figures, no buildings, no collectibles arranged in a grid. Full bleed portrait image. This is the LOADING hero background. A still intimate forest scene after dawn: softly layered slender pine trunks recede into luminous warm ivory mist in the upper half; fern fronds and a mossy fallen wood edge frame the bottom two corners. In the lower-middle foreground, a small naturally growing group of realistic chestnut-brown and ochre mushrooms, believable cap shapes and stalks, modest in number, with scattered pine needles and one small pine cone on damp reddish-brown earth. Mushrooms are environmental illustration only, not designed game pieces. The focal nature vignette sits from 60% to 79% image height. Leave the upper central 22%-50% calm, light sage and warm mist with very low detail for later title placement. Leave the bottom 12% dark and quiet for a loading bar. Fine leaf texture only near outer edges. Natural exposure, gentle highlights, no harsh sun disk, no strong path or road, no giant magical mushrooms. Beautiful coherent art, not stock photography collage.
